Hello Mrs. Sahar,

Unfortunately, we are unable to assist you further with this matter at this time, as the payment has been pending for the past 3 to 4 months. As the unit payment has not been completed, we are unable to proceed with any further actions.

We have previously assisted you with all matters despite the outstanding payments; however, at this stage, it is no longer possible to continue without settlement.

Thank you for your understanding.
